title: Restore packaged cafeteria v2 map for spear live
objective: Diagnose and repair the packaged Standalone-Development content failure where spear live cafeteria_500sqft_v2 exits with MapNotFound. Inspect the active Standalone/Saved staged pak contents for cafeteria_500sqft_v2 and cafeteria_500sqft_v2_flashlight_validation_dark, verify the cook/package artifact state, and if the active package is stale or missing those maps, run the appropriate cook/package workflow to restore them. Return exact commands run, package evidence, and the next user command to retry.
instructions: Start by confirming whether the active packaged runtime contains /Game/SPEAR/Scenes/cafeteria_500sqft_v2/Maps/cafeteria_500sqft_v2 and the dark validation map.
If missing, cook/package cafeteria_500sqft_v2 and cafeteria_500sqft_v2_flashlight_validation_dark for the current Linux Standalone-Development runtime using the project-standard UAT/run_uat workflow.
Do not change product code unless absolutely required; this is primarily a package/cook repair.
After cook/package, verify the pak or staged content includes the target map assets and report the exact retry command for spear live cafeteria_500sqft_v2 --setting realistic-2x.
constraints: Long-running Unreal/UAT commands are allowed for Experimenter.
Preserve logs under .control-tower/runs with a timestamped directory.
expected_outputs: ResultPacket with diagnosis, package evidence, commands run, and retry command.
definition_of_done: Either the active package contains both cafeteria target maps or the packet clearly explains the blocking failure and next manual step.
